alternativeHighlights: Usually supports either Telegram or Discord, not both
Usually supports either Mac or Windows, not both

Available on both Mac and Windows
24/7 AI monitoring with automatic message sync
Monitor unlimited channels at the same time
Start or pause anytime and customize monitoring frequency

Less reliance on personal Discord accounts and proxy setup
